description: This file defines the 'Article' controller class within the OpenCart Admin module, handling event-driven actions related to articles such as adding, editing, and deleting articles by scheduling tasks.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Controller class that manages article-related events by scheduling background tasks for add, edit, and delete actions.

methods.name: addArticle
methods.description: Schedules tasks to generate article listing and detail information when an article is added.

methods.name: editArticle
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update article listing and info when an article is edited.

methods.name: deleteArticle
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update listing and remove an article when it is deleted.
